steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's foreign-key rules over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 12 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug.

steps.title: What we decided last time
steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.
steps.finding: No past decisions on this drug.

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 962 days before the posting

sentences.text: FDA inspection 970483 ended 2016-04-12 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2016-07-13, which was 962 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2018-11-30.
A prior inspection 876911 ended 2014-03-28 and was classified OAI with six observations including absence of written procedures and deviations from laboratory control requirements.
FDA issued a Warning Letter on 2014-10-21 to the same facility.
Subsequent inspections 940389, 1125050, 1254066, and 1203129 were all classified VAI.
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 95 months.
Current inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 11 to 23 days on hand.
The rule-ranked alternate manufacturer is Samson Medical Technologies, L.L.C., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Q-61f836.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%cefazolin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%cefazolin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-156191.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('26de1ce9-06a9-486f-b27d-2ac635f018d1', '1dc9de56-e259-4546-a1db-23119a8a088e', '17f8f038-c204-4dab-80d7-6f7ac41ddbec') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-8f65f2.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%cefazolin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-79706b.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%cefazolin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-73e2cd.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%cefazolin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-deccfd.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3002807173', '3003802432', '3009831352') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-a926a9.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3002807173', '3003802432', '3009831352') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-0cdf0f.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3002807173') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('b braun', 'hikma farmaceutica s a', 'hikma farmaceutica s a estrada do rio da mo')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-3e8df1.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('b braun', 'hikma farmaceutica s a', 'hikma farmaceutica s a estrada do rio da mo', 'hikma', 'b braun medical', 'baxter') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%cefazolin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-70a8ec.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('876911') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-2eba21.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00143926225', '00143992390', '00264310511', '00338350841')

Q-83c4a7.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%cefazolin%'
